name: Bourbon Signal
subtitle: Fresh bourbon intelligence
promotionalText: See timely bourbon availability Signals, manage Radar preferences, and keep your bourbon hunt organized.
description:
Bourbon Signal gives members a focused, trustworthy view of timely bourbon availability intelligence. Create a free account in the app, then review Signals and manage your membership from one native experience.

Use the native app to:
• Review recent availability and release Signals
• Open details including retailer, timing, price, quantity, and source context when evidence supports them
• Monitor watched bottles, saved markets, and recent alerts in Radar
• Post a store sighting with optional photo evidence
• Keep saved bottles, ratings, and notes on Shelf
• Review membership, Signal Points, rewards, privacy, support, and account controls

iOS members can choose eligible Standard or Barrel subscriptions through Apple, restore purchases, and open App Store subscription management. Free is $0 with no renewal. Existing Founder access is honored but is not sold in the app. Any eligible trial is limited to qualifying monthly products and appears only when both the Bourbon Signal account and Apple confirm eligibility.

Availability changes quickly. Confirm with the retailer before travel or purchase.
contentRights: Confirm all final artwork and product-content rights before submission.
